method.direction: All new trials are reverse UDP: exit B to native client profile1. Profile2 contributes the second ordinary probe.
method.noise: 25,000/s for70s, one source/64ports,4096-datagram bursts, captured transport prefix + altered ciphertext.
method.useful: 6000/s or24000/s,128-byte UDP application payloads for60s. Existing separate iperf3 3.18 startup-reorder benchmark from v22; native VPN binaries/profiles are unchanged.
method.WAN: Half the requested RTT in each A-B direction, normal jitter10% of RTT per direction,16384-packet queues, no random loss. Both VPN and control channel delayed.
method.move: Gateway changes first NAT mapping25s after workload launch. Repeated moves restore original IP with a new NAT port; delay measured from first conntrack deletion completion.
method.delayed_discovery: Gateway intentionally drops profile1 outbound encrypted UDP for300/750ms at the first move. This also drops probe requests; counters retained separately. No client configuration is changed.
method.warmup: First three counted runs used the serial v22 warmup. The other counted runs use bounded continuous10pps warmup for both profiles, stopped before captures/counters/load. Proof deadlines unchanged.
method.measurement: Complete buffered inner UDP captures count unique source/receiver sequences, including GSO/GRO and short startup-control tails. Separate inner ICMP captures separate request loss, reply loss and one-second application deadlines.
method.CPU: All resident nominal250ms samples including startup; informational, no threshold. No compilation during traffic measurements.

limits.ownership: SHA-256 of peer public key plus scalar keypair creation time and local index; no plaintext or keypair pointers
limits.handoff_order: The sender remembers an encrypted packet before reading its endpoint. The receiver commits an authenticated new endpoint before the cache snapshot.

agent_versions.297b224a55c9891a346ed634e2971a4c56905221: same helper with SO_REUSEADDR before TCP bind; no change to proof/admission/recovery algorithms

startup_boundary.interpretation: The 1-second TCP connect timeout alone prevents the control channel in these three attempts. Longer raw TCP connections succeed; full mutual-TLS operation at this RTT was not demonstrated. The two pre-load failures are excluded from the traffic matrix.

preload_failures.r1400_description: Two attempts failed the two-flow admission prerequisite before load: serial warmup, then continuous warmup. Entry and exit status remained disconnected with zero queries. The subsequent TCP diagnostic shows the one-second connect deadline is insufficient at RTT1400/jitter140.
preload_failures.helper_bind_description: New exit helper bind failed with EADDRINUSE; the old socket file fooled the old readiness test. This was the twice250 pre-load attempt, not a traffic trial. The exact old socket state at failure was not captured.
preload_failures.capture_directory_description: The gate300 retry initially reused the excluded capture directory and was rejected before noise/useful load. The next attempt uses a new iteration ID and keeps old captures unchanged.

gate_syntax.reason: The new one-line table definition lacked a delimiter after the chain closing brace. nft rejected the entire NAT+gate transaction at25s; the requested move did not occur.

high_PPS_capture.reason: Full source UDP capture at24000/s lost frames; delivery counts cannot be inferred from it.

validation_attempt_correction: An initial five successful mTLS stop/restarts produced zero observed TIME_WAIT rows, so a requirement to observe TIME_WAIT failed. A later isolated graceful active-close negative control establishes rebind behavior; the final five successful helper restarts are retained separately. No traffic trial was discarded for this assertion.

helper_restart_checks.before_load_failure: New exit helper bind failed with EADDRINUSE; the old socket file fooled the old readiness test. This was the twice250 pre-load attempt, not a traffic trial. The exact old socket state at failure was not captured.
helper_restart_checks.fix: SO_REUSEADDR before TCP bind; fail preflight unless live MainPID owns the listening port and Unix socket exists. Not SO_REUSEPORT.

scope_limits: One observation per completed case, with no confidence interval or lossless roaming guarantee. Equal requested netem seeds do not isolate scheduling or packet timing.
The one-second probe deadline is unchanged; RTT near/above one second produces late replies even without movement. Complete tunnel captures and probe consumption are distinct.
No per-attempt cache replay trace was added. Loss attribution to bounds combines controlled scenarios, source inspection and deterministic tests.
Key rotation, shared-peer cache pressure,byte budget and pinned replay-window boundaries were tested deterministically, not as full WAN traffic cases in this stage.
Physical Windows/macOS/Android/iOS GUI clients, DPI/unlinkability, distributed noise and candidate exhaustion were not tested.
Longer-timeout raw TCP success at1400ms does not establish full mTLS or useful traffic support there.
A registered peer can still trigger bounded amplification without proving return reachability; repeated ciphertext is linkable.
Production servers,user VPN,Windows networking,personal JSON and GitHub were unchanged.
